data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'aelos', meaning 'dawn' or 'dusk'. In ancient Greek mythology, Aelber could refer to an elf or otherworldly being that dwelled in the twilight hours. This name carries a sense of mystery and connection to the natural world. The name Aelber carries the meaning “Elf or otherworldly being” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aelber usually hope their child will grow to embody elf or otherworldly being and live with faith, good character and purpose.
